panel.heading: Mbinye ego, onyinye na ojoro

cards.d: Enweghị nkwụghachi ụgwọ, mana kpachara anya na-akọ akụkọ banyere etu esi emefu ego na ihe ọ rụpụtara.
Jiri ọmụrụ nwa kwụọ ụgwọ. Gosi usoro ego gị. Ebinyela ihe karịrị ị nwere ike ịkwụghachi.
Akwụla ụgwọ ọ bụla iji hapụ onyinye. Ekekọrịtala PIN ma ọ bụ OTP gị. Lelee webụsaịtị gọọmentị.

say: A ghaghị iji ọmụrụ nwa kwụọ ụgwọ mbinye ego, ya mere onye na-agbazinye ego na-eleba anya n'ụzọ ego gị. Agbanyela ego karịa ka ị nwere ike ịkwụghachi, ma gụọ akwụkwọ ọ bụla tupu ịbanye.
